ME702.title: Automobile Engineering

ME703.title: Robotics

revaluation.process: Apply on the portal under Examinations > Revaluation within 7 days of result publication.

attendance_policy.condonation_note: Students between 65% and 75% may apply for condonation with valid medical or on-duty documents.

BTECH.name: B.Tech (4 years)
BTECH.eligibility: 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics, minimum 60% aggregate (55% for reserved categories), plus a valid EU Engineering Entrance (EUEE) or JEE Main score.

MTECH.name: M.Tech (2 years)
MTECH.eligibility: B.E./B.Tech in a relevant discipline with minimum 60% or CGPA 6.5; valid GATE score preferred, otherwise EU written test and interview.
MTECH.entrance: GATE score or EU test on 2027-06-12

MBA.name: MBA (2 years)
MBA.eligibility: Any bachelor's degree with minimum 50%; CAT/MAT/XAT score, followed by group discussion and interview.

PHD.name: Ph.D.
PHD.eligibility: Master's degree with minimum 60% (or CGPA 6.5); NET/GATE qualified candidates are exempt from the written test.
PHD.entrance: Written test and research interview, July 2027

scholarships: Merit scholarship: up to 50% tuition waiver for top 5% EUEE rank holders
Need-based fee concession for family income under INR 5 lakh per year
admissions.installments: Tuition can be paid in two instalments per year (July and January).
documents: Entrance exam score card (EUEE/JEE/GATE/CAT as applicable)
Government photo ID (e.g. Aadhaar card or passport)
Degree certificate and transcripts (PG and Ph.D. applicants)
admissions.staff_ward_concession: Children of Example University employees receive a 25% tuition concession.

grade_submission.edit_policy: Grades can be edited until you click 'Freeze'. After freezing, corrections need HoD approval via a grade change request.

leave_policy.approver: Head of Department, then the Dean for leave longer than 3 days
leave_policy.notes: Arrange class substitution in the portal before submitting. Leave during examination duty requires the Controller of Examinations' approval.

notice_publishing.approval: Notices to 'All' are reviewed by the Registrar's office before going live.

notices.title: Hall tickets for end-semester exams will be available from 16 November
Library extended hours during exam season start 15 November

library.timings: Mon-Sat 08:00-22:00, Sun 10:00-17:00 (24x7 reading room during exams)
library.eresources: IEEE Xplore, ACM DL, Springer and NPTEL via campus network or the library VPN

hostel.capacity: Separate boys' and girls' hostels with 2,400 beds in total
hostel.rooms: Double and triple sharing; limited single rooms for final-year students
hostel.fee_includes: Room, mess (4 meals/day), Wi-Fi and laundry twice a week
hostel.apply: Apply under Student Portal > Hostel > Room Request; allotment is by first-come, first-served with priority for first years.

role_notes.faculty: Faculty and staff quarters are handled by the Estate Office (ext. 2150), not the student hostel office.
role_notes.administrator: Current occupancy is 2,212 of 2,400 beds (92%). Allotment reports are under Admin Console > Hostel.

routes.via: City Bus Stand - Central Station - Campus

transport.pass: Apply under Student Portal > Transport; passes are issued within 3 working days.

role_notes.faculty: Staff may use any route; the annual fee is deducted from salary once you opt in on the HR portal.
role_notes.administrator: Route changes are approved by the Transport Committee; ridership reports are under Admin Console > Transport.

canteen.notes: Vegetarian and non-vegetarian options; UPI and campus ID card payments accepted. Meals from INR 40.

wifi.login: Sign in with your portal ID and password (WPA2-Enterprise / PEAP).
wifi.helpdesk: IT Helpdesk, Block A ground floor, ext. 2000 or it-help@example.edu
wifi.reset: Reset your network password from Portal > Account > Security.

medical.timings: 08:00-20:00 with a doctor; nurse on call 24x7
medical.emergency: Campus emergency line ext. 2999 (24x7) or 108 for an ambulance
medical.insurance: All students are covered by group health insurance up to INR 2 lakh.
medical.counselling: Free and confidential counselling at the Wellness Centre, Mon-Fri 10:00-17:00; book via portal.
medical.hospital: Example City General Hospital (tie-up), 4 km from campus

role_notes.student: Medical leave of more than 3 days needs a certificate from the Health Centre for attendance condonation.
role_notes.faculty: Staff are covered by the employee health scheme; claims go through the HR portal.
